messages:
deploy-bot: Scheduled deployment: runtime v2.3 rollout window opened for 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. Impact: rolling worker restarts, ~1-3s cold-start for few requests, failover to pinned model variants available. :gear:

lina: tagging this for statuspage copy and customer email. can someone draft? :eyes:

ben: I can draft an external-facing blurb. Want to confirm: is there a hard customer impact (errors) or just possible transient latency?

maya: product here — no expected errors, only short tail latency during restarts. fallback policy -> traffic should auto-route to compatible variants if a node fails. customers on Dedicated with strict pinning may see degraded throughput for ~5-10m if capacity low.

sam: ops-sre note: can confirm rolling restarts across shards, we'll do staggered batches of 20% capacity. rollback criteria: error rate >2% sustained for 5m OR latency p95 > 1.5x baseline for 10m.

emma: customer-succ: for customers in regulated industries we need to send an email 48h in advance. can we get a short template I can paste?

anna: devex — will add doc snippets to the changelog page. also suggest including the statuspage update and a short playbook for SREs.

chris: platform — note about version pinning: we should push a note to Dedicated users with pinned models: if they want to avoid any automatic variant fallback they must apply config `pinning.mode: strict` (default is compatible). we should call that out in comms.

ben: draft statuspage copy (short):

"Scheduled maintenance: Inference runtime upgrade (v2.3) — 2026-04-02 02:00–04:00 UTC
We will perform a rolling upgrade of the inference runtime to v2.3 to deploy performance and stability fixes. During this window customers may see brief increases in latency (1–3s) and short periods of degraded throughput for a subset of requests while workers restart. No customer data is expected to be affected.
Updates: https://status.redwood.ai
Estimated impact: brief transient latency and rolling restarts; automated fallback to compatible model variants enabled by default.
If you have strict model pinning enabled, you may experience degraded throughput; see guidance below to avoid fallbacks.
"

lina: looks good. brevity is good for statuspage. add contact line for urgent concerns.

ben: updated statuspage copy with contact: "If you experience degradations, contact support@redwood.ai or open a ticket."

ben: email template for customers (48h notice):

"Hello <CustomerName>,

We are scheduling a short maintenance window to upgrade our inference runtime to v2.3 on 2026-04-02 from 02:00 to 04:00 UTC. This update improves model serving stability and performance. During the window you may notice brief increases in response latency or short drops in throughput for a small fraction of requests. There is no expected data loss.

If you require uninterrupted throughput, you can enable strict pinning in your Dedicated configuration (`pinning.mode: strict`) — however, doing so may prevent automatic fallbacks and could increase the chance of transient throttling during the window.

If you have questions or want us to schedule a custom window, reply to this email or contact your account team.

Thanks,
Redwood Support
"

maya: can we add a short internal runbook snippet for oncall?

sam: runbook excerpt:
```
1) Monitor metrics: global error rate, p95 latency, capacity utilization per pool.
2) If error rate >2% sustained for 5m -> pause rollout (deploy-bot abort), rollback to runtime v2.2, and notify customers.
3) If p95 >1.5x baseline for 10m -> throttle rollout rate to 10% batches and escalate to eng-runtime.
4) For Dedicated pinned customers seeing impact -> offer temporary capacity burst or consult with account owner.
```

emma: perfect. I'll prep the 48h email and the support ticket macro. please confirm final statuspage copy and I'll publish.

chris: also sending a quick API snippet for statuspage update (for automation):
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.status.redwood.ai/v1/incidents \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $STATUS_API_KEY' \\n  -d '{"name":"Inference runtime upgrade v2.3","impact":"degraded_performance","message":"Rolling runtime upgrade 2026-04-02 02:00-04:00 UTC. Brief latency increases expected."}'
```

lina: final check: add dedicated customer note line and link to pinning docs. Ben -> can you add that to the statuspage text?

ben: done. final statuspage text ready. I'm publishing at T-24h unless anyone objects. :thumbsup:

lina: 👍 no objections. thanks everyone — ops will run the scheduled rollout and eng-runtime on standby. I'll post a follow-up thread with the live incident ID when published.
